name: Lake Maggiore
title: Holidays in Lake Maggiore
intro: A long Alpine lake of grand old resorts, palm-filled island gardens and mountain views, stretching from Italy into Switzerland. Here's what Lake Maggiore is like, when to go and how long to stay.
image_alt: The Brissago Islands in Lake Maggiore, seen through the trees from above
facts_note: The EU is bringing in new entry checks, so check the rules on GOV.UK before you book.
when_to_go: April to June and September are best, with island gardens in flower in spring and warm, calm days. July and August are warm and busier but good for swimming. Most island gardens open from late March to October, and winter is quiet.

things.name: Isola Bella
things.blurb: A baroque palace with terraced gardens and white peacocks, by boat from Stresa.

things.name: Isola Madre
things.blurb: Botanical gardens full of exotic plants, on a larger, calmer island.

things.name: Isola dei Pescatori
things.blurb: A small fishing island of lanes and lakeside restaurants.

things.name: Mottarone
things.blurb: A cable car or road up for views over seven lakes.

things.name: Villa Taranto
things.blurb: Huge gardens in Verbania, famous for tulips and dahlias.

things.name: Centovalli railway
things.blurb: A scenic train through a hundred valleys from Domodossola to Locarno.

faqs.question: Is Lake Maggiore worth visiting?
faqs.answer: Yes. It's less crowded than Lake Como, with beautiful island gardens, easy boat trips and good-value hotels.

faqs.question: How many days do you need at Lake Maggiore?
faqs.answer: Four to seven days lets you see the Borromean Islands, Villa Taranto and a mountain or railway trip.

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Lake Maggiore?
faqs.answer: April to June and September, around 17 to 25°C.

faqs.question: How do you get to Lake Maggiore?
faqs.answer: Fly into Milan Malpensa, which has direct flights from the UK. Stresa is about 45 minutes' drive away, or take the train from Milan.

faqs.question: Where should you stay on Lake Maggiore?
faqs.answer: Stresa is the classic base for the islands. Verbania is quieter, and Cannobio is pretty and close to Switzerland.
